## Configuration and switch evidence {#sec-ch15-ch12-tests}

A numerical test can silently exercise the wrong option or import the wrong package.
The configuration checks establish preconditions for interpreting @sec-ch12-matrix.

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Connect the chapter's claims to executable assertions.

**Data.** Test inputs and thresholds; no new solver measurements.

**Placement.** Verification outside the simulation step.

**Activation.** Select the named tests; this catalogue changes no defaults.

**Guarantee / limits.** Source coverage does not establish a runtime pass.

**Evidence.** The Tests layer distinguishes report checks from solver tests.
:::

### Derivation

The numerical derivations remain in the linked chapter. The error and conservation identities for interpreting
these tests are written out in the opening section of @sec-ch15; this inventory introduces no additional update equation.

### Numerical method

Read the assertion and its registration, then run the selected test in a build of the code pin.
Record device, precision, process count and skipped cases separately. @fig-ch15-evidence shows why an independent
formula check cannot establish that the compiled implementation ran.

: Assertion definitions for this catalogue. {#tbl-ch15-ch12-tests-sources}

The numbered source entries above map directly to the Tests table. CTest registration names and environments
come from `setup_test`, `snapy_add_python_test` and the explicit entries in
{{< code tests/CMakeLists.txt >}}. The `.release` suffix denotes a Release build;
other configurations use their build suffix through `setup_test`
({{< code cmake/macros/macro_setup_test.cmake >}}).

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_python_import_path_python` | Package origin and search-path ordering are correct | exact paths; exit 125 if unconfigured | Source assertion 1 |
| `test_hydro_options.release` | Unsupported implicit schemes are refused | exception | Source assertion 2 |
| `test_hydro_options.release` | Wall clamp is enabled by default and accepts overrides | boolean equality | Source assertion 3 |
| `test_yaml_keys.release` | Unknown geometry cell key is rejected | exception message contains key | Source assertion 4 |
| `test_x1_seam_split_x1_mass_covariance.release` | Two owned cells refused; three accepted | exception/no throw | Source assertion 5 |
| `test_x1_seam_split_vic_refuses_split.release` | Implicit column accepts one block and refuses a radial split | exception message | Source assertion 6 |

: Acceptance criteria read from the code pin; no solver pass is claimed. {#tbl-ch15-ch12-tests-assertions}

The `expect_refused` helper checks the key in the exception message
({{< code tests/test_yaml_keys.cpp expect_refused overload=1 >}};
{{< code tests/test_yaml_keys.cpp expect_refused overload=2 >}}).
The `seam_arm` registration requires the filtered test to report one passing test; an empty filter cannot
satisfy its pass expression ({{< code tests/CMakeLists.txt >}}).
`src/snapy_report/ch12/configuration_check.py` checks parser truth tables and rational/symbolic
reference, covariance and energy identities. It does not execute static C++ option caches.

### Limits

A minimum-cell guard establishes a refusal contract, not the accuracy of mass covariance.
Runtime results need the complete switch environment in addition to the package origin, device and rank count.
The selected assertions do not fill the unmeasured combinations in @sec-ch12-matrix.
